1. The plaintiff and the defendant are brothers and the registered owners of the house at 12 Gandhi Road under the registered sale deed.
2. The defendant has been in exclusive possession of the entire house since 2020 and has refused the plaintiff entry.
3. It is submitted that a co-owner is entitled to partition of the joint house by metes and bounds.

1. Paragraph 1 of the plaint is admitted to the extent that the parties are brothers and are the registered owners of the house.
2. Paragraph 2 of the plaint is denied. The defendant has never excluded the plaintiff.
3. It is submitted that the suit is barred by limitation because the plaintiff has known of the possession since 2012.
